purpose: 130 actual-program executions through the proved NativeIOZipper interpreter. All127 words of lengths0..6,plus lengths16/32/128. Independent binary conversion of numeric input length checks the padded result;exact original payload,blank tally,all3heads,input headL,halt and old output prefix checked.

import TransposeFollowup.InputMeasureRun
import TransposeFollowup.NativeIOZipper
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def measureMarkedExact (word : Tape Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (word.left.headD .blank=.start) && word.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  decide (word.right.take (xs.length+1)=symbols xs++[.stop]) &&
  (word.right.drop (xs.length+1)).all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))
def measureBits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map (fun j => n.testBit j)
def measureHeads : Fin 3 → Int := ![-7,29,-51]
def inputMeasureCheck (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let c : NativeIOZipper.Config (Fin 3) InputMeasure.Label :=
    ⟨⟨⟨InputMeasure.start,InputMeasure.initial⟩,measureHeads⟩,0,[true,false]⟩
  let r:=NativeIOZipper.run InputMeasure.program xs (37*xs.length+53) c
  decide (r.work.core.pc=.done) && (List.finRange 3).all (fun p => decide (r.work.pos p=measureHeads p)) &&
    measureMarkedExact (r.work.core.tapes 0) xs &&
    (r.work.core.tapes 1).left.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    (r.work.core.tapes 1).right.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
    measureMarkedExact (r.work.core.tapes 2) (measureBits xs.length xs.length) &&
    decide (r.inputPos=xs.length) && decide (r.outRev=[true,false])

def measureWords : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (measureWords n).flatMap (fun xs => [false::xs,true::xs])
def inputMeasureTests : List Bool :=
  ((List.range 7).flatMap measureWords).map inputMeasureCheck ++
  [inputMeasureCheck (List.replicate 16 false),inputMeasureCheck (List.replicate 32 true),
   inputMeasureCheck ((List.range 128).map (fun j => decide (j%3=0)))]
#eval (inputMeasureTests.count true,inputMeasureTests.count false)
